youtube.title: Why we record every client conversation
youtube.description:
When you work with us, every email, text, phone call and Zoom meeting is recorded and filed in your own secure folder. Your goals and preferences never get lost, even with 600 questions coming in a month.

#septic #septicbusiness #clientservice #marketingagency

youtube.title: Want your septic company in AI answers? Publish your prices.
youtube.description:
If your local competitors hide their prices and you publish yours, you become the company AI search recommends. It is the biggest single lever we have seen for showing up in ChatGPT, Gemini and Google's AI results.

#septic #aisearch #septicpumping #localseo

youtube.title: Septic customers are finding you through ChatGPT now
youtube.description:
More homeowners now ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI who to call for septic service. With attribution tracking on every call, text and form, you see exactly which leads came from AI.

#septic #chatgpt #leadtracking #septicbusiness

youtube.title: How we measure where your septic company ranks in AI search
youtube.description:
Real searches, run in your service area on the top four AI platforms, show who comes up first, second and third. Your dashboard shows where you stand against the competition.

#septic #aivisibility #septicmarketing #localbusiness

youtube.title: Google keeps pushing businesses to show their prices
youtube.description:
Show your prices and Google shows you more often. Septic companies that made this change are getting calls, texts and form leads from AI search today.

#septic #localseo #pricing #septicpumping

youtube.title: Afraid competitors will undercut your septic prices?
youtube.description:
Your competitors probably already know what you charge. Those calls asking for a quick pump-out price and then hanging up? They happen every day. Publishing your prices gives away nothing they don't already have.

#septic #septicbusiness #pricing #competition

youtube.title: A $1,200 pump-out with a $500 coupon: should you copy it?
youtube.description:
One septic company lists pump-outs at $1,200 and offers $500 off. Some customers will bite. The ones who compare prices trust that company less. A fair, clear price builds more trust than a markdown.

#septic #pumpout #pricingstrategy #septicbusiness

youtube.title: What car shopping for five new drivers taught us about pricing
youtube.description:
We would rather buy where the sticker price is the price you pay. Most of your septic customers feel the same way. They want transparency, and they want to trust you.

#septic #customertrust #pricing #smallbusiness

youtube.title: Repair first, replace second: why honesty wins on Google
youtube.description:
Homeowners can't see inside their septic system, the same way most of us can't judge a mechanic. The company that recommends the repair before the replacement earns trust, and trust is what Google ranks.

#septic #septicrepair #honestbusiness #septicservice

youtube.title: Google's business model, and where your septic company fits in it
youtube.description:
Google wants its users happy, so it shows the businesses most likely to treat customers well. Reviews are a big part of that trust. Prices you show up front are the other part.

#septic #googlereviews #localseo #septicmarketing

youtube.title: Google's AI now calls septic companies for quotes
youtube.description:
A Get a Quote button on the Google Business Profile has Google's voice AI call four or five companies and send the prices back to the homeowner. It started with HVAC and plumbing, and one of our septic clients just got the first call.

#septic #googlebusinessprofile #voiceai #septicbusiness

youtube.title: Pricing septic pump-outs by distance from your yard
youtube.description:
Diesel, wear on the truck and the drive to the dump site all add up. Inspections and installs can travel farther because the job is worth more, but pumping prices need to follow the miles.

#septic #pumptruck #septicpumping #pricing

youtube.title: How to put septic prices on your website when they vary
youtube.description:
Give a range, list your tiers, price the first thousand gallons, or show a starting price. Your website doesn't need every number. It needs a number.

#septic #septicwebsite #pricing #septicpumping

youtube.title: Publishing install prices brought one septic company more installs
youtube.description:
One of our clients put prices on the two system models they install most. They now show up in Google and AI search for those jobs and book more of them. Don't overthink which prices to share.

#septic #septicinstall #septicsystem #septicbusiness

youtube.title: Why we build septic websites on Astro instead of WordPress
youtube.description:
Modern sites built with AI tools load fast, and speed helps you rank. The harder part is the formula: the right information, the right trust signals for Google, and a page that turns visitors into customers.

#septic #septicwebsite #webdesign #seo
